title: Fire resistance barley wine

infobox.Crafting Materials: Barley wine base: Fire resistance x1

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Fire resistance barley wine is a Plains-tier consumable item fermented from Barley wine base: Fire resistance.

sections.heading: Recipe
sections.text:
Barley wine base: Fire resistance is produced in a Mead ketill with:
• 10 Barley
• 10 Cloudberries
Six Fire resistance barley wines are produced by fermenting the wine base for two in-game days.

sections.heading: Effect
sections.text: Consuming it grants Resistant vs. Fire for 600s (10 minutes), reducing fire damage taken (see resistance for details).

Introduction. Fire resistance barley wine is a Plains-tier consumable item fermented from Barley wine base: Fire resistance.

Recipe. Barley wine base: Fire resistance is produced in a Mead ketill with:
• 10 Barley
• 10 Cloudberries
Six Fire resistance barley wines are produced by fermenting the wine base for two in-game days.

Effect. Consuming it grants Resistant vs. Fire for 600s (10 minutes), reducing fire damage taken (see resistance for details).
